# Wardline

> Wardline is a credit union for the AI economy. Communities pool USDC on NEAR, earn yield by backing AI agents' payments, and vote together on the risks they take. For an agent, Wardline is a payment layer that only pays on proof: a model call is paid only when a NEAR AI TEE signature shows the model you asked for signed that exact response, spending comes from a group's deposit that caps every member, and every payee is checked before money moves. Agents integrate with one line (the OpenAI client's base URL), MCP or the SDK.

Three layers:
1. The Mutual: anyone deposits USDC and gets WARD, a share of the pool. WARD holders earn 2% of every proven AI payment, vote on payouts, fees and covered models, and cover a wrong approval after Wardline's own first-loss stake.
2. Groups: a team, hacker house or DAO funds a shared AI budget from its Sputnik DAO or Trezu treasury. Reputation tiers: Bronze 2%, Silver 1.5%, Gold 1% fee; clean proven calls move a group up, a paid claim moves it down.
3. The proof engine: the right party, the model you actually got, a hard cap.

## Paying for AI calls

Point any OpenAI-compatible client at the gateway with a meter key (wk_..., one per budget member):

```ts
import OpenAI from "openai";
const client = new OpenAI({ baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/ai", apiKey: process.env.WARDLINE_METER_KEY });
```

```python
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/ai", api_key=os.environ["WARDLINE_METER_KEY"])
```

Routes: POST /v1/ai/chat/completions, GET /v1/ai/models, GET /v1/ai/calls/{call_id}, GET /v1/ai/budgets/{budget_id}. Non-streaming only; stream: true is refused with 400.

Each call: Wardline reserves the most it can cost, sends your request bytes unchanged to NEAR AI Cloud, hashes the exact response, fetches the provider_tee signature over "<model>:<sha256 request>:<sha256 response>", checks the EIP-191 signer is attested for that model, then pays. Any failure releases the whole reservation. The signature shows which model's TEE signed those bytes. It does not prove token counts; the charge uses the provider's reported usage, capped at the reservation.

Response headers: X-Wardline-Proof (verified or refused), X-Wardline-Call, X-Wardline-Settlement, X-Wardline-Model-Proven, X-Wardline-Amount, X-Wardline-Refund.

Errors: 402 with error.type "spend_limit_reached" and code ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED or BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when a member allowance or the budget deposit is used up; nothing is sent to the model. 502 with error.type "proof_refused" and a code (MODEL_MISMATCH, SIGNATURE_MISSING, RESPONSE_HASH_MISMATCH, REPLAYED, SIGNER_NOT_ATTESTED, BAD_SIGNATURE_KIND, ...) when a response is not proven; you were not charged. 504 when the provider times out; refunded.

SDK: createWardline({ mode: "hosted", baseUrl, meterKey }).openai(OpenAI) returns a configured OpenAI client. getCall(callId) returns the call with its proof, and verifyProof(call, { responseBytes }) re-checks it locally.

Signers attested per model: GET /v1/ai-registry.

Money is Circle's USDC on NEAR (6 decimals). Wardline Mutual (GET /v1/mutual, GET /v1/pool) pays a group back when a Wardline approval was wrong. Wardline's own first-loss stake pays first; after that, holders of WARD ("Wardline Mutual share", NEP-141, 6 decimals) cover the rest. WARD is minted for USDC at price = pool assets / WARD supply, starting at 1 USDC. It is yield-bearing and loss-sharing: it rises with fees and falls when a payout goes past Wardline's stake. Redeem with the pool after a 7-day wait, or sell on a DEX.

## The Mutual, groups and voting

- GET /v1/mutual: pool, WARD price, yield earned, groups covered, proven payments, payouts, the leaderboard, tier rules and proposals.
- GET /v1/groups and GET /v1/reputation/{budget_id}: get_reputation answers tier, proven_calls, refused_calls, claims, fee_bps and coverage_cap.
- GET /v1/mutual/proposals, GET /v1/mutual/proposals/{id}/weight/{account}, POST /v1/mutual/proposals/{id}/execute (anyone, once, after it passed).
- Deposit, redeem, vote and propose are signed by the holder's NEAR wallet: POST /v1/pool/challenge with {account, action: "deposit" | "withdraw" | "redeem" | "vote" | "propose", ...}, sign the message (NEP-413, recipient "wardline-mutual"), then POST /v1/pool/submit.
- Votes weigh WARD at the proposal's snapshot. Quorum is 20% of the snapshot; the window is 3 days; more than half of the snapshot voting for passes it early.

Reputation tiers and voting are simulated until their contracts deploy; the pool, budgets and model registry are NEAR contracts on testnet.

## When to use which

- You know the vendor's website: call resolve. It returns the account linked to that domain, so you never handle a raw address.
- You have a raw address, from an invoice, an email or an x402 offer: call check before paying.

Accounts are CAIP-10 strings: near:testnet:northwind.testnet, eip155:84532:0xabc..., solana:devnet:7xKX... A bare NEAR account id is also accepted.

## Verdicts

- PAY: pay. The account is linked to this vendor's domain and nothing looks wrong.
- HOLD: do not pay. Send it to a human. Reasons: NOT_IN_REGISTRY, CHAIN_NOT_VERIFIED, COOLING_OFF, NEW_ACCOUNT, RECENT_FULL_ACCESS_KEY, RECENT_CODE_CHANGE, PAYEE_CHANGED, SIGNALS_UNAVAILABLE.
- BLOCK: never pay. Reasons: ACCOUNT_MISSING, LOOKALIKE_ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_NOT_VENDORS.

If a call fails or returns an error, there is no verdict. Do not pay.

## Evidence tiers

Every answer has an evidenceTier. It says what was verified, never legal ownership.

- T0_NONE: nothing verified for this vendor and account.
- T1_WALLET_CONTROL: the account signed our challenge.
- T2_DOMAIN_LINKED: T1, and the vendor's domain lists the account. PAY needs at least this.
- T3_RELATIONSHIP: T2, and your owner approved the account or you paid it before. Needs your API key.
- T4_EXTERNAL_KYB: reserved for an outside business-verification provider. Never set today.

## MCP

Streamable HTTP: http://127.0.0.1:8790/mcp
Stdio: node services/mcp/dist/stdio.js
Tools: resolve_payee, check_payee, get_vendor, how_to_verify, get_ai_spend (read-only; needs WARDLINE_METER_KEY)

## HTTP

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8787

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/resolve -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"domain":"northwind.example","chain":"near:testnet"}'

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/check -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"payee":"near:testnet:northw1nd.testnet","vendor":{"domain":"northwind.example"}}'
```

Other routes: GET /v1/vendors, GET /v1/vendors/{domain}, POST /v1/payments/record, POST /v1/vendors/verify, GET /.well-known/wardline-attestor.json.

Passing "payer" needs that payer's API key: Authorization: Bearer rk_... Recording payments needs a key with the record scope, or the payer's NEAR signature.

Free tier: 200 calls per day per IP. Over that, HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements of 0.01 USDC per call. Paying it is not available yet.

## SDK

```ts
import { createWardline, assertPayable } from "@wardline/sdk";
const wardline = createWardline({ mode: "hosted", baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8787" });
const result = await wardline.resolve({ domain: "northwind.example", chain: "near:testnet" });
assertPayable(result);
pay(result.account);
```

Direct mode runs the checks locally, so Wardline never sees who you pay: createWardline({ mode: "direct", nearRpcUrl, registryAccount }).

x402: wrapFetchWithPayment(withWardline(fetch, { wardline }), x402Client), from @wardline/x402-guard.

## Receipts

Hosted answers carry an ed25519 receipt signed by the Wardline API, covering the verdict, reasons and evidence tier. The public key is at /.well-known/wardline-attestor.json. Check one with verifyReceipt(result, publicKey, { request }). Direct mode has no receipts.

## For vendors

Serve https://<domain>/.well-known/wardline-payee.json, signed by each payout account, then POST {"domain":"<domain>"} to /v1/vendors/verify. That gives T2_DOMAIN_LINKED. The how_to_verify tool has the steps.
